entries.wording: Tu envío se encuentra pendiente de ingreso.
entries.note: Under the Pendiente de ingreso milestone: the sender announced the parcel; Andreani does not have it yet.

entries.wording: ¡Ya tenemos tu envío! El circuito comienza en C.a.b.a., Buenos Aires. Pronto lo enviaremos a la sucursal encargada de la entrega.
entries.note: Under the Ingresado milestone. The town and province are where the journey starts.

entries.wording: Tu envío salió de la sucursal Monserrat (av Belgrano), en la localidad C.a.b.a. de la provincia Buenos Aires.
entries.note: Under the En camino milestone.

entries.wording: Tu envío se encuentra en camino a la sucursal La Plata (calle 2).
entries.note: Under the En camino milestone. The branch named is the one that delivers.

entries.wording: La sucursal La Plata (calle 2) ya está procesando tu envío. ¡Pronto tendrás novedades!
entries.note: Under the En camino milestone: the delivering branch received the parcel.

entries.wording: Hoy te visitaremos para entregarte tu envío.
entries.note: Under the En camino milestone.

entries.wording: Ya entregamos tu envío. ¡Esperamos volver a verte pronto!
entries.note: Under the Entregado milestone.

entries.wording: Pendiente de ingreso
entries.note: A milestone heading of the tracker, and the parcel's current milestone while Andreani waits for it.

entries.wording: Ingresado
entries.note: A milestone heading of the tracker.

entries.wording: En camino
entries.note: A milestone heading of the tracker. Its lines run from the parcel leaving the first branch to the day's delivery round.

entries.wording: Entregado
entries.note: A milestone heading of the tracker, and the parcel's current milestone once delivered.

entries.wording: Aún no recibimos tu envío. Suscribite al servicio de notificaciones y te enviaremos las novedades por e-mail
entries.note: The sender created the shipment; Andreani does not have it yet. Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.

entries.wording: Ya tenemos tu envío. Lo estamos preparando para enviarlo a la sucursal a cargo de la entrega
entries.note: Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.

entries.wording: Envío ingresado al circuito operativo
entries.note: An older wording of the same event. Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.

entries.wording: El envío está viajando a la sucursal responsable de la entrega
entries.note: Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.

entries.wording: Tu envío llegó a la sucursal a cargo de la entrega. Suscribite al servicio de notificaciones y te enviaremos novedades por e-mail
entries.note: Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.

entries.wording: En el día de hoy estaremos visitando el domicilio de entrega
entries.note: Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.

entries.wording: El envío fue entregado
entries.note: Its reason says where: at the recipient's address or at an Andreani branch. Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.

entries.wording: Aún no recibimos tu envío, seguramente lo recibiremos en las próximas 72 horas. Suscribite al servicio de notificaciones y te enviaremos las novedades por e-mail
entries.note: An older wording of the shipment-created event. Seen in an archived capture of Andreani's former tracker page.

entries.wording: Entregado en Domicilio de Destinatario
entries.note: The reason detail of a delivery. Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.

entries.wording: Entregado en Sucursal Andreani
entries.note: The reason detail of a delivery collected at a branch. Seen in an archived reply of the former tracking service behind Andreani's tracker.
